source: NEC 2026, Table 120.45 — lighting load demand factors (dwelling units)
note: Only the 'Dwelling units' occupancy rows are transcribed (hospitals/hotels/warehouses out of scope). Applies to the pooled general lighting (120.41) + small-appliance + laundry (120.52) VA, applied marginally per tier: first 3,000 VA at 100%; 3,001–120,000 at 35%; remainder at 25%. Renumbering chain: Table 220.42 (through 2020) → Table 220.45 (2023) → Table 120.45 (2026, the Article 220→120 relocation); tier values unchanged 2014 through 2026. Cross-verified 2026-08-28 against an IEEE-hosted verbatim NEC 2014 Art. 220 reproduction and 2023/2026 secondary mirrors (ecmweb demand-factor article, Sparky Toolbox 2026 worked example, Design Master docs), 0 mismatches. Official 2026 text paywalled.
